briefdescription.para: This file defines the RefCountedBase, ThreadSafeRefCountedBase, and IntrusiveRefCntPtr classes.

detaileddescription.para: IntrusiveRefCntPtr is a smart pointer to an object which maintains a reference count. (ThreadSafe)RefCountedBase is a mixin class that adds a refcount member variable and methods for updating the refcount. An object that inherits from (ThreadSafe)RefCountedBase deletes itself when its refcount hits zero.
You can use IntrusiveRefCntPtr with isa<T>(), dyn_cast<T>(), etc.:
